measurements.name: Pacific North Equatorial Countercurrent
measurements.range_interpretation: Two reported model change states, not series minimum/maximum, an annual range or confidence limits. No width error reported.
measurements.geographic_scope: Western Pacific; 0-10 N meridional integration and 135-155 E zonal averaging. No geographic current edges extracted.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional distance from a transport-weighted latitude axis; not diagnosed flow-normal paired edges.
measurements.layer: 0-150 m velocity-weight integration. Bounds define the operator support, not physical current edges at every depth.
measurements.time_convention: 1960-2014 OFES model context; 13-month running-mean diagnostic. Exact dates of the two reported change states are unextracted; not observation dates or annual extrema.
measurements.boundary_rule: No edge threshold. Equation 3 is the eastward-transport-weighted mean absolute distance from the equation 2 axis.
measurements.source_citation: Chen, X., B. Qiu, Y. Du, S. Chen and Y. Qi (2016), Interannual and interdecadal variability of the North Equatorial Countercurrent in the Western Pacific, doi:10.1002/2016JC012190.
measurements.source_locator: Section 4.2, equations 1-3 (printed pp7748-7749 / PDF 6-7); Figure 8 (PDF 9); conclusion p7757 / PDF 15; model data p7744 / PDF 2.
measurements.extraction_method: Approximate kilometre states transcribed from original conclusion; formula and degree-axis figure checked visually. No curve digitization, unit conversion, raw-model reconstruction or full-width conversion.
